id./param/scenario/cs/b_090_cs_005.pack|cs_: "Hey! Did you folks hear that rumor too and come all this way?
"The world ended and everyone's depressed. They say there's a paradise in Octagonia that heals those wounds.
"A traveling martial artist I passed also said she was going to Octagonia. Everyone's desperate to be healed.
"That martial artist was a real beauty. Maybe I'll see her again in paradise. Heh heh...
"A beautiful traveling martial artist...? Could it be...
"My friend's here. See you, travelers. If we're fated, we'll meet again in Octagonia.
"You're late! Where were you slacking off!? Let's go! Paradise is near!
"A beautiful martial artist... It may well be Jade..."
